recent_articles.title: BBC at the site of China's worst mining disaster in more than a decade
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 82 people have been killed and two are missing after a gas explosion at the Liushenyu Coal Mine in Shanxi province, China.  **Chinese President Xi Jinping** has ordered full efforts for rescue operations. The blast is the worst mining disaster in China since 2009, according to state media reports. **The BBC's China correspondent Stephen McDonell** is at the scene of the blast.

recent_articles.title: Civilians must not be attacked ‘anywhere’, Pakistan tells UNSC - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan's** ambassador to the UN, Asim Iftikhar Ahmad, urged an immediate ceasefire and renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war in Ukraine during a UN Security Council emergency meeting.  He emphasized that civilians must not be attacked in armed conflict and called for lasting peace through dialogue and cessation of hostilities. **Unicef** director of operations and advocacy, Edem Wosornu, stated that nearly 16,000 civilians have been killed and over 44,000 injured in Ukraine since the war began in February 2022, while **Ted Chaiban**, deputy executive director of **Unicef**, highlighted that more than 3,400 children have been killed or injured since the escalation of the war in 2022.

recent_articles.title: 25 terrorists killed in Bannu clash - Newspaper - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A fierce clash between **police**, a peace committee, and terrorists in Bannu district resulted in the deaths of at least 25 terrorists, two police officers, and two civilians.  **Police** sources confirmed that the operation was launched after receiving information about the presence of a large number of terrorists in the area. The **Lakki Marwat police peace committee** also arrived to support the Bannu police.  The operation led to the deaths of two key terrorist commanders, Zmari Noor and Abdullah.

recent_articles.title: School, residential buildings hit as Russia pounds Ukraine capital Kyiv with missiles, drones; 4 dead - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Russia** launched a massive missile and drone attack on **Kyiv**, Ukraine, early Sunday morning, striking residential areas, a school, and commercial buildings. The attack resulted in at least four deaths and numerous injuries, with fires erupting in multiple districts and forcing residents into underground shelters.  **Ukraine's** military administration reported damage to several districts across the capital, including a school hit during an ongoing strike drone attack. **President Volodymyr Zelenskyy** warned of potential retaliation from **Russia** following recent Ukrainian attacks in occupied territory.

recent_articles.title: Senegal football fans return home after royal pardon in Morocco | Football News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **King Mohammed VI** of **Morocco** granted a humanitarian pardon to 15 Senegalese football supporters who were jailed following the chaotic Africa Cup of Nations final in January. The supporters, arrested for hooliganism after Senegal's victory over Morocco, returned home on Sunday and were welcomed by **Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye**.  The incident has strained relations between the two countries but the pardon was granted to mend ties.
